title: Recording with Basie and Jimmy Rushing in California, released years later
summary: After Basie left, he visited her in California and they made a session that Columbia only released recently, after her Muse album with Eddie Vinson. She also did an earlier session with Jimmy Rushing.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Oh yeah. And then after he left the Band I came out here to California to live - - didn't come to live, I was already here. And he used to plan to visit with me all the time and we'd go to different places. He and I made a record session out here.
Columbia just released it after I did that Muse Album with Cleanhead*. Because I had done that with Jimmy Rushing.
Many years ago, and they never did
* Helen Humes & the Muse All Stars, Muse MR 5217, recorded in October, 1979.
